item.title: There Is Uncertainty Facing Some Hyundai and Kia Electric Models
item.description: Hyundai and Kia have yet to release information for the 2026 model year for both the Ioniq 6 sedan and the EV6 SUV, leaving their future in doubt.

item.title: The 12 Best Affordable Performance Cars (and Trucks and SUVs!) You Can Buy
item.description: Looking for a sporty and capable ride in 2026? These vehicles, all starting at under $60,000, deliver performance without robbing you blind.

item.title: Tested: 2026 Subaru Outback Wilderness Answers the Call of the Wild
item.description: With a new adaptive suspension, updated infotainment, and available leather upholstery, the 2026 Outback Wilderness is a loyal companion for any terrain.

item.title: Subaru Exec Reportedly Says the STI Performance Brand 'Isn't Dead'
item.description: The automaker has been paying close attention to fan reactions to its concepts, with an STI EV looking more and more likely.

item.title: Ford F-150's Supercharger Kit Turns the Lobo into a 700-HP Street Truck
item.description: If the Lobo's 400-hp 5.0-liter V-8 doesn't pack a big enough punch, Ford's $10,250 factory-backed supercharger should fix that.
